householdCreation.heading: Set up your Household
householdCreation.description: Choose your Locale and Currency to get started. Both are yours to change later.
householdCreation.errorGeneric: Something went wrong creating your Household. Please try again.

householdInvite.expiresNote: This link expires in 7 days and can be used once.
householdInvite.errorGeneric: Something went wrong creating the invite. Please try again.
householdInvite.acceptDescription: You've been invited to join a Household. Accepting gives you the same full access as every other member.
householdInvite.invalid: This invite link is no longer valid. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
householdInvite.error: Something went wrong loading this invite. Please try again.
householdInvite.alreadyInHousehold: You already belong to a Household, so this invite link doesn't apply to you.

taggingScaffold.heading: Rooms, Power Points & Devices
taggingScaffold.confirmDeleteRoom: Delete this Room? It will be archived, not removed, so any historical data stays valid.
taggingScaffold.confirmDeletePowerPoint: Delete this Power Point? It will be archived, not removed, so any historical data stays valid.
taggingScaffold.confirmDeleteDevice: Delete this Device? It will be archived, not removed, so any historical data stays valid.
taggingScaffold.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
taggingScaffold.errorParentArchived: That parent was archived in the meantime. Please refresh and try again.
taggingScaffold.moveDescriptionPowerPoint: Choose a new Room. History already logged keeps its original Room, Power Point, and Device identity — this only changes where it lives going forward.
taggingScaffold.moveDescriptionDevice: Choose a new Power Point. History already logged keeps its original Room, Power Point, and Device identity — this only changes where it lives going forward.
taggingScaffold.noDestinations: No other option is available to move to.

yearlyBaseline.heading: Yearly Baseline
yearlyBaseline.description: Set the amount of electricity your Household expects to use in a year. Pattern Detective measures your consumption pace against this. Changing it only affects readings from now on.
yearlyBaseline.errorGeneric: Something went wrong saving your Yearly Baseline. Please try again.
yearlyBaseline.errorConflict: This Yearly Baseline was changed elsewhere in the meantime. We've loaded the latest value below — please review and save again.
yearlyBaseline.errorConflictRefetchFailed: This Yearly Baseline was changed elsewhere in the meantime, and we couldn't load the latest value. Please reload the page before saving again.

meterReading.savedOffline: Saved — will sync when you're back online
meterReading.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

meterRegression.title: That reading is lower than the last one
meterRegression.description: You entered {{kwh}} kWh on {{readingTime}}, but your last reading was {{previousKwh}} kWh on {{previousReadingTime}}. This usually means the meter was reset or it rolled over its digit limit — not that your consumption went backwards. Pick which one happened.
meterRegression.resetActionDescription: New meter installed, or a manual reset. Starts a fresh baseline sequence going forward.
meterRegression.rolloverActionDescription: Old meter hit its max digit count and wrapped back to zero. Consumption is computed across the wrap.
meterRegression.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

status.lowConfidenceNote: It's been a while since your last reading — treat this as a rough estimate.
status.emptyBody: Log your first reading to get started — Pattern Detective needs at least two to find your pace.

smartPlugImport.heading: Smart Plug Import
smartPlugImport.dropHint: Drop a file here, or choose one to upload.
smartPlugImport.formats: Accepts Eve Home exports (.xlsx) or Meross exports (.csv).
smartPlugImport.asyncNote: Uploaded. We're parsing this in the background — you'll get a notification when it's done. Feel free to leave this screen; nothing here needs to stay open.
smartPlugImport.flaggedForReviewTitle: Needs a look before it's used
smartPlugImport.errorGeneric: Something went wrong uploading this file. Please try again.
smartPlugImport.errorUnsupportedType: That file type isn't supported. Please choose an .xlsx or .csv export.

gaps.estimatedDetail: No data received for {{days}} days. Filled from the preceding week's average ({{dailyAverage}} kWh/day) and flagged as estimated — never counted as measured.
gaps.missingDetail: No data received for {{days}} days. This Power Point doesn't yet have a full preceding week of history to average from, so this range is left unfilled and flagged as missing — not interpolated from nothing.
gaps.flaggedForReviewDetail: Every day in this file's date range came back with no interval data — flagged for review rather than wholesale-interpolated.

mappingModal.title: New Power Point: "{{deviceTag}}"
mappingModal.body: This file is tagged to a Power Point that doesn't exist in your household yet. Create it, or map this data to one you already have — nothing is imported until you choose.
mappingModal.noRooms: You don't have any Rooms yet. Add one in Settings before creating a Power Point here.
mappingModal.orDivider: or map to an existing one
mappingModal.mapError: Something went wrong mapping this import. Please try again.
